column1: # tests/glossary-whitelist.tsv -- justified exceptions of tests/glossarycheck.cx (docs/glossary.md section 6).
# RULE<TAB>PATH<TAB>COUNT<TAB>REASON: up to COUNT findings of RULE in PATH are allowed; more is red.  The ratchet only
# goes down: lower COUNT when a use is fixed, delete the row at 0.  A new .cx or a new .md gets no row -- it is held
# to prd.md section 0 from its first commit.  Reason classes: STREAM (the word means a stream -- correct meaning, bare
# spelling, existing text), DATA KEY / FILE NAME / CLI / GATE LAYER (a byte-parity or sealed spelling, not prose),
# EXEC UNIT (an exec/ delta directory), NOT A TERM (another English sense), NET (a real misuse kept for an owner
# ruling, marked TODO(term)).  Existing .cx symbols are not renamed here (glossary section 4).
